title: Duterte family’s alleged mansions, luxury spending, appalling – Luistro
summary: MANILA, Philippines — House lead prosecutor, Batangas Rep. Gerville “Jinky” Luistro, on Tuesday questioned the Duterte family’s image of simple living amid reports of alleged mansions and expensive…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House lead prosecutor, Batangas Rep. Gerville “Jinky” Luistro, on Tuesday questioned the Duterte family’s image of simple living amid reports of alleged mansions and expensive purchases linked to the family. “They tried to give an impression to us na sila ay simpleng pamilya lang na may simpleng buhay, but how can we characterize them as simple people kung meron silang mansion, meron silang his and hers (swimming pools), sabi ng NBI,” Luistro said at a press briefing. “This is not simple living, I believe,” she added.
